verdicts.reason: A is a coherent left-to-right banner with a clear headline, readable body and a prominent CTA, but the 'OBSIDIAN ONE' eyebrow has been moved below the body copy (wrong reading order), the logo is centred over left-aligned text, and the headphones are cropped hard against the left edge. B has an oversized two-line headline with 'don't.' orphaned on the second line, while the eyebrow and body copy are shrunk to unreadable micro-text and scattered on the right. The logo is pushed to the bottom, which leaves no grouping and a broken hierarchy.
